actions.name: actions_run
actions.description: Turn meeting notes or a transcript into a clean action-item checklist (owners and due dates where implied). Writes it live on the page and returns it.

inputSchema.notes: string — the notes or transcript to extract action items from. Required.

adforge.name: adforge_run
adforge.description: Forge three Meta ad concepts from a site URL (or the lent brand). Renders them live on the page and returns them.

inputSchema.url: string — a site to forge ads from. Optional when a brand is lent.

adgen.name: adgen_run
adgen.description: Draft a wall of six ad directions from a site URL (or the lent brand). Renders them live on the page and returns them.

inputSchema.url: string — a site to draft ad directions from. Optional when a brand is lent.

adpulse.name: adpulse_diagnose
adpulse.description: Diagnose a Meta Ads Manager export (CSV) — health score, wins, leaks, ranked actions, and per-campaign verdicts. Renders the readout live and returns it.

inputSchema.csv: string — a Meta Ads Manager CSV export. Optional when data is already loaded.

anthem.name: anthem_run
anthem.description: Write an original song (structured lyrics + a copy-ready generation prompt) about a person, moment, or brand. Writes it live on the page and returns it.

inputSchema.subject: string — what the song is about (a person, a moment, or a brand). Required.

aplus.name: aplus_write
aplus.description: Write a full Amazon A+ content stack for a product (a line or a product-page URL). Renders it live on the page and returns it.

inputSchema.product: string — the product to write A+ content for. Optional when a brand is lent.

arcade.name: arcade_run
arcade.description: Turn one line into a playable HTML5 game. Builds it live on the page (sandboxed) and returns the game's title.

inputSchema.idea: string — one line describing the game to build. Required.

arcana.name: arcana_run
arcana.description: Deal a fresh three-card tarot spread for a question and read it live on the page. Returns the drawn cards and the reading.

inputSchema.question: string — the question to read for. Optional; a default is used if omitted.

bank.name: bank_ask
bank.description: Ask the context bank a question, answered from the user's own notes. Streams the answer onto the page and returns it.

inputSchema.question: string — the question to answer from the vault. Required.

batch.name: batch_draft
batch.description: Draft a full YC application (all 8 answers, one recommended each, plus the two video scripts) from a one-line idea. Fills the cards live on the page and returns the drafted application as markdown; nothing is locked or submitted.

inputSchema.idea: string — one line on what you're building. Required.

canvas.name: canvas_run
canvas.description: Describe a diagram, board, or layout in words and get an editable, self-contained HTML document. Renders it live on the page and returns the document HTML.

inputSchema.prompt: string — one line describing the diagram/board/layout to draw. Required.

caption.name: caption_run
caption.description: Write 5 social captions plus a hashtag set for a post, one marked recommended. Writes them live on the page and returns them.

inputSchema.about: string — what the post or photo is. Required.

cartridge.name: cartridge_run
cartridge.description: Forge a complete, self-contained HTML5 game from one idea. Generates it live on the page and returns the game's title.

inputSchema.idea: string — one line describing the game to make. Required.

chat.name: chat_send
chat.description: Send a message in the chat and get the reply. Answers live on the page in the active thread and returns the assistant's reply text.

inputSchema.message: string — the message to send. Required.

clipfix.name: clipfix_run
clipfix.description: Clean pasted text: fix smart-quotes, unwrap hard line breaks, strip tracking params from URLs, tidy whitespace. Writes the cleaned text live on the page and returns it.

inputSchema.text: string — the pasted text to clean. Required.

coldemail.name: coldemail_run
coldemail.description: Write a short, non-cringe cold email (subject + body + one clear ask) from a target and an ask. Writes it live on the page and returns it.

inputSchema.brief: string — who you're emailing and the ask. Required.

commit.name: commit_run
commit.description: Write a Conventional Commits message (typed subject + body bullets) from a diff or change summary. Writes it live on the page and returns it.

inputSchema.diff: string — the diff or change summary to describe. Required.

compare.name: compare_run
compare.description: Compare options side by side (pros/cons per option) with one recommendation. Writes the comparison live on the page and returns it.

inputSchema.items: string — the options to compare (e.g. 'A vs B vs C for X'). Required.

convert.name: convert_run
convert.description: Convert data between CSV/JSON/YAML entirely on-device (no AI). Auto-detects the source; give a target format. Writes it on the page and returns the converted text.

inputSchema.input: string — the data to convert (CSV, JSON, or YAML). Required.
inputSchema.from: string — source format hint 'csv'|'json'|'yaml'. Optional; auto-detected when omitted.
inputSchema.to: string — target format 'csv'|'json'|'yaml'. Default: JSON (or YAML when the source is JSON).

copyflow.name: copyflow_record
copyflow.description: Author a routine from a 2-step demo: step 1 fetches JSON from a URL, step 2 appends a row of values to a target. CopyFlow saves the recording trace, generalizes it into a parameterized routine with the user's Claude, and shows it on the Review view for the user to confirm. Returns the compiled routine JSON (NOT yet confirmed — confirming is the user's standing grant).

inputSchema.fetchUrl: string — the URL step 1 fetches JSON from. Required.
inputSchema.appendTarget: string — where step 2 appends the row (a sheet id / connector target). Required.
inputSchema.appendValues: string — the new row's values, comma-separated or a JSON array. Optional.
inputSchema.title: string — a name for the routine. Optional.
inputSchema.fetchIntent: string — plain-language description of step 1. Optional.
inputSchema.appendIntent: string — plain-language description of step 2. Optional.

crest.name: crest_run
crest.description: Turn a one-line brand brief into a logo: a brand foundation, three directions (one recommended), a chosen visual style, and four concrete marks (SVG wireframe + a real image rendered on your Higgsfield). Runs live on the page and returns the result.

inputSchema.brief: string — brand name + what it does / who it's for / any vibe. Required.
inputSchema.style: string — OPTIONAL. One of: 3D isometric, flat, monoline, monochrome, 2D illustrative, pixel art, gradient, bold, emblem, geometric, negative space, retro. Defaults to the recommended style.

cron.name: cron_run
cron.description: Convert a plain-English schedule to a cron expression (with a human-readable confirmation), or explain a cron expression field by field. Writes it live on the page and returns it.

inputSchema.schedule: string — a schedule to convert, or a cron expression to explain. Required.

cut.name: cut_run
cut.description: Turn a video transcript (or rough notes) into a cut plan: on-screen captions + a highlight cut list (keep MM:SS–MM:SS with a reason) + what to trim. Writes it live on the page and returns it.

inputSchema.transcript: string — the video transcript or rough notes to plan a cut from. Required.

deck.name: deck_build
deck.description: Turn notes, an outline, or a topic into a structured slide deck (a title slide plus content slides, each with a title, bullets, and an optional speaker note). Builds it live on the page and returns the outline; the user exports a real .pptx from the page.

inputSchema.notes: string — notes, an outline, or a topic to turn into a slide deck. Required.

docstring.name: docstring_run
docstring.description: Write a clear docstring/JSDoc for a function — params, returns, one example — in the language's own convention. Writes it live on the page and returns it.

inputSchema.code: string — the function source to document. Required.

dreamlog.name: dreamlog_run
dreamlog.description: Interpret a dream. Writes the reading live on the page and returns it.

inputSchema.dream: string — the dream to interpret, in the dreamer's own words. Required.

dub.name: dub_run
dub.description: Transcribe an audio clip (locally) and split it into a speaker-labelled, ordered script (diarize). Pass the audio as a data: URL. Runs live on the page and returns the script plus whether speakers were diarized or inferred; choosing a voice per speaker and regenerating happens on the page.

inputSchema.audio: string — the audio clip as a data: URL (e.g. data:audio/wav;base64,…). Required.

echo.name: echo_speak
echo.description: Speak text aloud with a local, on-device voice model. Plays the audio on the page and returns which local backend spoke it.

inputSchema.text: string — the text to read aloud. Required.

emboss.name: emboss_apply
emboss.description: Apply the user's saved brand profile (letterhead, signature, stamp) to a document and produce a branded PDF, entirely on-device (no AI). Composes the given text into a new PDF and surfaces the download.

inputSchema.text: string — the document body text to compose into a branded PDF. Required for compose.
inputSchema.title: string — optional document heading.
inputSchema.mode: string — 'compose' (default). Only compose is supported via this tool.
inputSchema.profile: string — optional profile name to use; defaults to the active one.

emote.name: emote_run
emote.description: Turn a one-line character description into a die-cut sticker pack, drawn on the page via your Higgsfield. Returns the sticker image URLs.

inputSchema.character: string — one line describing the character or mascot. Required.

errslate.name: errslate_run
errslate.description: Decode an error message or stack trace: what it means, the likely cause, and the fix. Writes it live on the page and returns it.

inputSchema.error: string — the error message or stack trace to decode. Required.

explainthis.name: explainthis_run
explainthis.description: Explain a bit of text in plain English for a smart non-expert. Writes it live on the page and returns it.

inputSchema.text: string — the text to explain. Required.

extract.name: extract_run
extract.description: Pull the key fields and entities out of a bit of text into a clean labeled list. Writes it live on the page and returns it.

inputSchema.text: string — the text to extract fields from. Required.

formula.name: formula_run
formula.description: Write the exact spreadsheet formula for a plain-English need (Google Sheets + Excel), with one line explaining it. Writes it live on the page and returns it.

inputSchema.need: string — the spreadsheet need in plain English. Required.

gist.name: gist_run
gist.description: Summarize a bit of text into a tight TL;DR (2 sentences + up to 4 bullets). Writes it live on the page and returns it.

inputSchema.text: string — the text to summarize. Required.

hooks.name: hooks_run
hooks.description: Write 7 scroll-stopping opening lines (hooks) for a topic, one marked recommended. Writes them live on the page and returns them.

inputSchema.topic: string — what the post/video/email is about. Required.

huddle.name: huddle_notes
huddle.description: Turn a meeting into clean notes: TL;DR, decisions, action items with owners, and per-topic notes. Pass a transcript, or an audio file as a data:audio/… URL (transcribed locally). Writes the notes live on the page and returns them.

inputSchema.transcript: string — the meeting transcript or rough notes. Provide this OR audio.
inputSchema.audio: string — an audio recording as a data:audio/… URL, transcribed locally on the device. Provide this OR transcript.

ideabrain.name: ideabrain_validate
ideabrain.description: Pressure-test a one-line startup idea: reads it into a brief, runs a validation pass, and returns a verdict that states the risk (not hype). Writes it live on the page.

inputSchema.idea: string — one line describing the idea to validate. Required.

identity.name: identity_compose
identity.description: Compose an AI creator persona (person, voice, look, audience, pillars — one recommended each) from a one-line brief. Fills the cards live on the page and returns the drafted persona; it does not publish it to Cast.

inputSchema.brief: string — one line describing the creator (niche, vibe, who they're for). Required.

imagegen.name: imagegen_generate
imagegen.description: Generate an image from a text prompt on your Higgsfield. Renders it live on the page and returns the image URL. Optionally guided by a reference image.

inputSchema.prompt: string — what to generate (subject, setting, lighting…). Required.
inputSchema.reference: string — OPTIONAL. A data: URL of a reference image to guide the render (image-to-image).

inkling.name: inkling_run
inkling.description: Turn one tattoo idea into three flash concepts and render the recommended one's line art on the page via your Higgsfield. Returns the concepts and any rendered image URLs.

inputSchema.idea: string — the tattoo idea and placement/size. Required.

marquee.name: marquee_build
marquee.description: Build a cinematic scrolling landing page from one line: writes a complete self-contained HTML page into the live preview and paints its hero on your Higgsfield. Returns the page HTML.

inputSchema.brief: string — one line on what the landing page is for. Required.

meetnotes.name: meetnotes_run
meetnotes.description: Turn a meeting transcript or rough notes into clean structured notes (TL;DR, decisions, action items with owners/dues, open questions). Writes it live on the page and returns it.

inputSchema.transcript: string — the meeting transcript or rough notes to structure. Required.

meme.name: meme_run
meme.description: Write meme concepts for a topic (or brand angle) and draw the recommended one on the page. Returns the concepts (format + captions).

inputSchema.topic: string — the topic or angle to meme. Required.

nameit.name: nameit_run
nameit.description: Propose six strong name options (each with a rationale) for a described product, company, feature, or project. Writes them live on the page and returns them.

inputSchema.description: string — a description of the thing to name. Required.

natal.name: natal_run
natal.description: Read a natal / birth chart from birth data. Renders the chart on the page and returns it.

inputSchema.date: string — date of birth, YYYY-MM-DD. Required.
inputSchema.place: string — birthplace (city, country) — the rising depends on it. Required.
inputSchema.time: string — time of birth, HH:MM (24h). Optional; omit if unknown.
inputSchema.name: string — the person's name. Optional.

objection.name: objection_run
objection.description: Reframe a sales or investor objection and draft a calm, honest response plus a one-liner. Writes it live on the page and returns it.

inputSchema.objection: string — the objection you're facing. Required.

outline.name: outline_run
outline.description: Produce a clean hierarchical outline for a post, talk, or doc, with a suggested hook and CTA. Writes it live on the page and returns it.

inputSchema.topic: string — what you're writing or presenting. Required.

palette.name: palette_extract
palette.description: Extract a color palette (dominant colors as HEX) from an image entirely on-device (no AI). Give a data: URL; returns the swatches as HEX + RGB.

inputSchema.dataUrl: string — the source image as a data: URL (or bare base64). Required.
inputSchema.count: number — how many colors to extract (4, 6, 8, or 12). Default 6.

pdftools.name: pdftools_run
pdftools.description: Merge, split, or compress PDFs entirely on-device (no AI). Pass PDFs as data: URLs; returns the resulting PDF(s) as data: URLs.

inputSchema.files: string[] — the source PDFs as data: URLs. Merge needs 2+; split/compress use the first.
inputSchema.range: string — split page range, e.g. '1-3,5' (blank = all pages). Optional.

petrait.name: petrait_run
petrait.description: Dream up regal portrait concepts of a pet from one line and paint the recommended one on the user's Higgsfield. Renders live on the page and returns the portrait URL.

inputSchema.pet: string — one line about the pet (e.g. 'a grumpy orange tabby named Biscuit'). Required.

polish.name: polish_run
polish.description: Proofread and clarify a bit of text while keeping the author's voice. Writes it live on the page and returns it.

inputSchema.text: string — the text to polish. Required.

qr.name: qr_make
qr.description: Generate a QR code from text or a URL entirely on-device (no AI). Returns the QR as an SVG string and a PNG data: URL.

inputSchema.text: string — the text or URL to encode. Required.
inputSchema.size: number — pixel size of the output. Default 320.

reachout.name: reachout_draft
reachout.description: Draft and stage (as Gmail DRAFTS — never sends) the next due outreach touches for the active Reachout campaign. Renders the board live and returns a summary.

inputSchema.campaignId: string — optional; defaults to the active campaign.

recap.name: recap_run
recap.description: Summarize a long doc or thread into a structured recap (TL;DR, key points, decisions, next steps). Writes it live on the page and returns it.

inputSchema.document: string — the long document or thread to recap. Required.

reel.name: reel_generate
reel.description: Draft a promo/launch reel from one line: writes a 4–6 scene script and paints each scene on your Higgsfield, live on the page. Returns the scenes (title, subtitle, image URL); it does not render the final video.

inputSchema.brief: string — one line on what the reel is for. Required.

regex.name: regex_run
regex.description: Write a regular expression for a plain-English matching need, with 3 matching + 3 non-matching test cases and a brief breakdown. Writes it live on the page and returns it.

inputSchema.need: string — describe what you need to match (and what you don't). Required.

rephrase.name: rephrase_run
rephrase.description: Rewrite a bit of text in a requested tone/length, keeping its meaning. Writes it live on the page and returns it.

inputSchema.text: string — the text to rewrite. Required.

reply.name: reply_run
reply.description: Draft reply options (concise, warm, firm) to a message or thread. Writes them live on the page and returns them.

inputSchema.message: string — the message or thread to reply to. Required.

repurpose.name: repurpose_run
repurpose.description: Rewrite one piece of content into an X thread, a LinkedIn post, an Instagram caption, and a short-form video script. Writes them live on the page and returns them.

inputSchema.content: string — the content to repurpose. Required.

resize.name: resize_image
resize.description: Resize/convert/compress an image entirely on-device (no AI). Give a data: URL and target size/format; returns the resized image as a data: URL. mode: 'long'|'width'|'percent'.

inputSchema.dataUrl: string — the source image as a data: URL (or bare base64). Required.
inputSchema.mode: string — 'long' (cap longest side), 'width' (exact width), or 'percent'. Default 'long'.

rizz.name: rizz_run
rizz.description: Get send-ready dating-app lines for a situation (their bio, their last message, or the vibe). Writes them live on the page and returns them.

inputSchema.situation: string — the situation to work with. Required.

roast.name: roast_run
roast.description: Roast a bit of text (a bio, brand blurb, resume, or pitch). Writes the roast live on the page and returns it.

inputSchema.target: string — the text to roast. Required.

roomify.name: roomify_run
roomify.description: Pitch three restyle directions for a room from one line and repaint the recommended one on the user's Higgsfield. Renders live on the page and returns the room image URL.

inputSchema.room: string — the room + the vibe (e.g. 'small living room, cozy japandi'). Required.

shelf.name: shelf_triage
shelf.description: Triage an inventory sheet (CSV of stock + sales) into reorder / watch / dead-weight, ABC, and one-week plans. Renders the board live and returns it.

inputSchema.sheet: string — CSV of stock + sales. Optional when a brand's inventory is lent (or the demo is used).

shell.name: shell_run
shell.description: Give the exact shell command(s) for a task, with each flag explained — and a warning above anything destructive. Writes it live on the page and returns it.

inputSchema.task: string — describe the task you want a shell command for. Required.

snap.name: snap_run
snap.description: Answer a question directly and concisely on the user's own Claude. Writes the answer live on the page and returns it.

inputSchema.question: string — the question to answer. Required.

spellout.name: spellout_run
spellout.description: Expand a rough phrase or shorthand into a clear, well-formed sentence or short paragraph, keeping the meaning and voice. Writes it live on the page and returns it.

inputSchema.phrase: string — the rough phrase to spell out. Required.

standup.name: standup_run
standup.description: Turn raw notes or commits into a crisp Yesterday / Today / Blockers standup. Writes it live on the page and returns it.

inputSchema.notes: string — your raw notes, commits, or bullets. Required.

steps.name: steps_run
steps.description: Turn a goal into a few distinct step-by-step plans, each a numbered checklist. Writes them live on the page and returns them.

inputSchema.goal: string — the goal to turn into steps. Required.

storybook.name: storybook_run
storybook.description: Write an illustrated children's picture book from one line. Writes it live on the page and illustrates each page; returns the book title and its page text.

inputSchema.idea: string — the story idea and who the hero is. Required.

studio.name: studio_shoot
studio.description: Shoot one product photo on your Higgsfield from a product description. Develops it into the contact sheet and returns the image URL.

inputSchema.product: string — the product to shoot (one line). Required.

take.name: take_script
take.description: Draft a recording script (beats for a screen or camera take) from a line describing what you're recording. Renders on the page and returns the recommended script; it does not start a recording.

inputSchema.about: string — what you're recording (e.g. 'a 40-second walkthrough of the pricing page'). Required.

thumbs.name: thumbs_run
thumbs.description: Draft three click-worthy YouTube thumbnail concepts from a video title (composition + big text overlay + emotion), rendered on the page. Returns the concepts; render each on your Higgsfield from the page.

inputSchema.title: string — the video title (e.g. "I tried the world's spiciest ramen"). Required.

titles.name: titles_run
titles.description: Write 8 headline/title options for a topic across styles, one marked recommended. Writes them live on the page and returns them.

inputSchema.topic: string — what the piece is about. Required.

toon.name: toon_run
toon.description: Storyboard a one-line moment into a 4-panel comic treatment (art style + recurring character + four beats), rendered on the page. Returns the storyboard; ink each panel from the page.

inputSchema.moment: string — the one line to turn into a comic. Required.

translate.name: translate_run
translate.description: Translate a bit of text into a target language, preserving tone. Writes it live on the page and returns it.

inputSchema.text: string — the text to translate. Required.

unjargon.name: unjargon_run
unjargon.description: Decode dense text (acronyms, legalese, jargon) into plain English. Writes it live on the page and returns it.

inputSchema.text: string — the dense text to decode. Required.

yearbook.name: yearbook_run
yearbook.description: Shoot a subject as retro yearbook portraits across the decades on the user's Higgsfield. Develops them live on the page and returns the portrait URLs.

inputSchema.subject: string — one line about who to yearbook (e.g. 'my roommate Dev, curly hair, always in a hoodie'). Required.
